SELECT status, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) dist_ids, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.order_ts_utc, o.line_count, o.order_total_gross, p.category, s.store_id, COUNT(*) lines
FROM fact_web_order o
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-27' AND DATE '2025-11-29'
  AND (p.category = 'ZZ Test' OR s.store_id = 999)
GROUP BY ALL

calls.statement: SELECT COUNT(*) total, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) dist FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= DATE '2025-11-20' AND order_ts_utc < DATE '2025-12-05'

SELECT 'dupe_content' k, COUNT(*) n FROM (
  SELECT member_key, order_ts_utc, order_total_gross, line_count, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' GROUP BY ALL HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'null_ts', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'noncancel_nolines_28', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND status<>'cancelled' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines_wrong_count', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND status<>'cancelled' AND line_count <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test_cat_web_orders_all', COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order o JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category='ZZ Test'
